meta.source: Authored for Mosaic 1.0 (Drupal 11 page builder) from the Mosaic authoring brief. No prior brand assets existed; every value below is chosen, not copied.
meta.themeIndependence: No token resolves to a Claro, Gin or Olivero variable. The builder paints itself from these tokens under any admin theme.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The builder canvas ground behind the page preview, and the page ground of the libraries admin screen. Never holds text directly.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Palette, property rail, dialogs, cards, table rows. Primary ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: empty states, developer disclosures, the field-map table body. Ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating over `surface`: the selection toolbar, popovers, the dialog panel. Pair with `shadow-md` or `shadow-lg`. Ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on rows, palette cards and quiet buttons. Ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The ground of the currently selected component, rail row or palette card. Ground for `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog only. Mosaic never uses a scrim for loading — the canvas stays interactive while the preview refreshes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover`, `surface-selected` and every `-subtle` ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help text, result lines, counts, slot rules. Reads on `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover` and `surface-selected`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, machine names in the developer disclosure, disabled labels. Reads on `surface` and `surface-sunken` at 14px or larger only.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `brand` or `data` fill. Prefer the `on-brand` / `on-data` tokens where those fills are used.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Structural 1px borders and dividers between panels, rail sections and table rows. Decorative — not required to carry 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The border of every input, select, checkbox and unchecked toggle. Carries meaning, so it holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: line-faint
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a panel — between fields in one rail section, between rows of a field map.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Mosaic's identity colour: primary button fill, selection outline, the drop indicator, the active tab underline. Fill it with `on-brand` text.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of any `brand` fill or `brand` text link.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet brand ground: the selected palette group, the `Ready` badge, the in-sync pill. Ground for `ink` and `brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `brand` or `brand-strong` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring, drawn with a 2px `surface` offset so it stays visible on top of a `brand` fill. Holds 3:1 on every surface in its theme.

tokens.name: data
tokens.usage: Everything to do with binding: the DATA badge, the bound-field marker, the bind control, the result line's icon. Fill it with `on-data` text.

tokens.name: data-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the DATA badge, the bound-field row and the Data section header. Ground for `ink` and `data`.

tokens.name: on-data
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `data` fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, in sync, Ready, a passing WCAG summary. Never the only cue — always beside a check glyph and a word.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a success banner or pill. Ground for `ink` and `success`.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Readiness `Attention`, unsaved changes, a slot below its minimum, a legacy binding. Never the only cue — always beside a triangle glyph and the reason.

tokens.name: attention-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of an attention banner, badge or required-slot strip. Ground for `ink` and `attention`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Readiness `Blocked`, a failing data source, a save error, the Remove action. Never the only cue — always beside an alert glyph and a sentence.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger banner, badge or invalid field. Ground for `ink` and `danger`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral explanation: the style-ownership line, keyboard-move hints, the Restricted badge. Never the only cue — always beside a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of an info banner or the ownership line. Ground for `ink` and `info`.

tokens.name: slot-line
tokens.usage: The dashed outline of an empty slot and the hover outline of a drop target. Decorative — the slot's label carries the meaning.

tokens.name: stale-wash
tokens.usage: The moving band of the stale shimmer while the server preview catches up. Decorative and suppressed under reduced motion.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The cover and the admin page title only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Dialog titles and the libraries admin section headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The name of the selected component at the top of the property rail; a card's name.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: A rail section heading once expanded; a slot's label on the canvas.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Every input value, option label, table cell and banner sentence. The default.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Field labels, button labels, the enabled component's name in a table row.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Palette blurbs and dense table cells on the admin screens.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Rail section headers and toolbar group labels, set in upper case.

styles.name: help
styles.usage: Help text under a field, slot rules, the result line, the status line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badge text and the breakpoint switcher, set in upper case.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Machine names, View ids and plugin ids inside the developer disclosure.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: The field-map source column and inline keyboard shortcut keys.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Mosaic never uses a spacing value that is not on this scale.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Reset a browser default; never a chosen gap.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: The gap between a badge glyph and its word; the focus-ring offset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a field label and its control; between stacked badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control: the gap between a button's icon and its label; between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between two fields in the same rail section; a card's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The padding of a rail section, a banner and a palette card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between rail sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The padding of a dialog body and an admin page block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks on the admin screens; the canvas gutter at 1440.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The inner padding of an empty-canvas or empty-slot state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above and below a page-level empty state.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The top and bottom inset of the full-screen focus mode.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, the drop indicator's caps, badge corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, quiet buttons, toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Filled buttons, banners, palette cards, rail section wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, the selection toolbar, admin cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The builder frame itself inside the node form.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, the segmented switcher and the in-sync indicator.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Every structural border and input border.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: The selection outline on the canvas and the active tab underline.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, drawn as an outline with a 2px offset.

size.note: Fixed sizes the builder's chrome depends on. Every interactive target is at least 44px in one dimension and never below 28px in the other.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons and badges inside dense admin tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: The default height of an input, select and button in the rail.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons in a dialog footer and on the front-end edit dialog.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The minimum touch target on tablet and mobile; controls grow to this, they do not shrink.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The property rail at 1440 and 1024.

tokens.name: palette-width
tokens.usage: The component palette at 1440.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: The floating selection toolbar on the canvas.

tokens.name: thumb-height
tokens.usage: A palette card's component thumbnail.

shadow.note: Three steps only. Elevation states what floats above what; it is never decoration.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: A palette card on hover and a dense admin card.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: The selection toolbar and any popover.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: A modal dialog and the media picker.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus and pressed transitions on controls.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: A rail section opening, a badge appearing, the drop indicator settling.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: A dialog entering and the full-screen focus mode.

tokens.name: dur-shimmer
tokens.usage: One pass of the stale shimmer while the server preview refreshes.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or settling: a dialog, a section opening, a dropped component.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Anything that moves between two held positions, such as the segmented switcher's thumb.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: a dismissed banner, a closing popover.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control. The control keeps its border so its shape is still readable.

tokens.name: opacity-stale
tokens.usage: A component's preview while the server catches up with an optimistic edit.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost
tokens.usage: The component being dragged, left behind at its origin.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: The rendered layout.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Selection outlines, slot outlines and the drop indicator.

tokens.name: z-toolbar
tokens.usage: The floating selection toolbar.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the bind picker and the breakpoint menu.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: The scrim and any modal dialog.

tokens.name: z-alert
tokens.usage: The save-error summary, which must never be covered.
